# CKA analysis for ablation_occ_detach_s3 (Detach+BN, seed 45)

CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/ablation_occ_detach_s3/openvla-7b+libero_spatial_no_noops+b8+lr-0.0005+lora-r32+dropout-0.0--image_aug--ablation_occ_detach_s3"

echo "Done. Results in /root/autodl-tmp/analysis/cka_s3_verification/"
